facts.textJa: ギデオンは戻った時に塔を壊すとペヌエルの人々へ告げました。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: He went up there to Penuel, and spoke to them in the same way; and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered.
He spoke also to the men of Penuel, saying, “When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.”
He broke down the tower of Penuel, and killed the men of the city.
